propositions: When structured-parse retries exhaust OUTPUT_RETRIES in the prompted branch of _pai_structured, the raw reply is discarded and the failure becomes non-replayable; an opt-in artifact capture mechanism is needed.

A new config key llm.parse_failure_artifact_dir must be added to LLMConfig and resolved via _llm_str in from_env, following the reserved-section pattern for llm.* keys, defaulting to None to preserve current behavior.

On final parse failure in _pai_structured, if parse_failure_artifact_dir is set, write one timestamped file containing the raw reply text, model id, contract name, and attempt count; append the artifact path to the raised error message.
Best-effort artifact writes must never mask the original parse error; unwritable directories and I/O failures are swallowed, and the terminal validation error is always raised unchanged.
Artifacts are rotated by mtime to keep at most 20 per directory, preventing unbounded disk growth on unattended hosts.
